1101000|I spy with my little eye 
something beginning 
with 'BOSS'!▽
And a three-headed 
boss at that!▽
If you can't hit the 
<R>correct head</R>, you 
won't be damaging this guy!▽
And you'll need to get its 
HP down to zero in order 
to win!▽
Better get to work!▽
Hit the correct head, take it 
down, and walk away with 
a <R>5-star coin</R>!|1|0|10|0|0|BOSS_01|Jolly good show! That's 
your first boss beaten!▽
And that means you can
move on to the next area!▽
Next stop: Mt. Wildwood!
Don't spare the horses!▽
Ah, but you'll want to use
that 5-Star Coin first!▽
Oh, oh, oh, and there's
something else!▽
Did you see the manhole
cover we passed?▽
You can use that to get
into a lovely sewer!▽
The Yo-kai there are
tough, that's for certain...▽
But I can smell something
delicious down there!|100101501|null*1121000|Ugh! Now these are the 
kinds of bosses I simply 
cannot bear!▽
Infuriating types who like to 
<R>mess with the puzzle 
area!</R>▽
You'll have to keep your
wits about you with this one!▽
Keep an eye on the 
countdown and time your 
work well!|1|0|2|0|0|BOSS_02|So that was the cutthroat
captain of Catfish Pond?▽
He was certainly no drip!
Anyway, onward! Next
stop: Blossom Heights!▽
I can't wait to buy some
sensational sweetmeats!▽
Take me to the Candy 
Stop right this instant!|100202001|null*1111000|Ah! Sproink! This sweaty 
oaf's weak spot is his 
<R>belly button</R>.▽
But if you want him to 
show it, you'll need 
to be clever!▽

he throws out occasionally.▽
It may seem a mad method
but it's the way to win this!▽|1|1111000|10|0|0|BOSS_03|Well he certainly got me
all hot and bothered!▽
Phewee!
Now, let's hit the city!▽
Downtown Springdale,
here we come!▽
You can treat me to a
soda from Nom Burger!|100302501|null*1131000|It's not just his face that's
massive, you know.▽
His attacks are awfully
enormous too!▽

Oh, and keep an eye on
the countdown too!▽

and put you right off your game!|1|0|15|0|0|BOSS_04|By jove, he shook me

Ooh, decisions, decisions!|100402501|null*1161000|Ooh, this one's a bad one!
